title: Ward Lodge
intro: Located in the heart of Camp Pendleton, Ward Lodge can offer the comfort you and your family are looking for at a very competitive price. We can accommodate the whole family, including pets!

sections.heading: Information
sections.markdown:
**Pricing**

Please visit [Inns of the Corps](https://lodgingreservations.usmc-mccs.org/Search/Index/13517/90/) or contact property for pricing and availability.

*Leisure can only book 30 days in advance and for a max of 7 days.*

**Room Amenities**

- High-Speed Internet Access
- Refrigerator
- Microwave
- Flat Screen TV/Cable
- Kitchenettes Include Cooking/Dining Utensils
- Coffee Maker w/ Free Coffee

**Lodge Amenities**

- Laundry Facility
- Playground
- Dog Run
- Picnic Area w/ BBQ Grills
- [Nearby Shopping and Dining](https://www.mccscp.com/shopping-services-food)

ADA-compliant rooms are available.

sections.heading: Pets
sections.markdown:
We have 16 pet-friendly rooms available:

- Standard rooms with one queen bed (2)
- Standard rooms with two queen beds (5)
- Kitchenette rooms with one queen bed (2)
- Kitchenette rooms with two queen beds (7)

**Pet Fees**

Please visit [Inns of the Corps](https://lodgingreservations.usmc-mccs.org/Search/Index/13517/90/) or contact property for pricing and availability.

*Orders must be verified at the time of check-in to receive rate.*

**Pet Policy**

Dogs weighing 50 pounds or less are welcome. Dogs over 50 pounds may be permitted but require prior approval. Pet owners must sign a liability waiver at check-in and supply shot records. Dogs left unattended in rooms must be placed in an acceptable kennel for the safety of other guests. Cleaning fees may apply. Per **base policy**, Pit Bulls, Staffordshire Terriers, Wolf Hybrid, and Rottweilers are not permitted.
